description: Compare current performance against a saved baseline. Flags regressions in memory (>20% increase), CPU (>50% increase), and jank rate (>25% increase). Thresholds are configurable.

baselinePath.description: Path to the saved baseline JSON file

cpuThreshold.description: CPU regression threshold in percent (0-1000, default 50%)

jankThreshold.description: Jank rate regression threshold in percent (0-1000, default 25%)

memoryThreshold.description: Memory regression threshold in percent (0-1000, default 20%)

name: adb_regression_check
